title: Legend overlaps the plot when there are more than 8 series
body: With 9 or more series the legend box is drawn on top of the lines. Expected it to move outside. Version 2.3.1.
label: bug

title: savefig() writes an empty PNG on Windows
body: Calling savefig('out.png') right after show() produces a blank 0-byte file. Works on Linux.
label: bug

title: How do I set different colours per bar?
body: I have a bar chart with five bars and want each one a different colour. Is there a parameter for this?
label: question

title: Option to put tick labels inside the axis
body: Would be nice to have tick labels drawn inside the plot area for compact dashboards.
label: feature

title: Example in the quickstart uses a removed argument
body: The quickstart calls plot(data, style='dark') but style was removed in 2.0. The example fails.
label: docs

title: Log scale crashes with zero values
body: Setting yscale='log' when the data contains 0 raises ValueError: math domain error. A warning would be better than a crash.
label: bug

title: Is there a way to share an x axis between two plots?
